figures.caption: Map: Battle of Badr (plan)

sourceNote: Printed page 50: a sideways (rotated) full-page plan of the Battle of Badr titled “جنگِ بدر کا نقشہ” with a compass arrow, dotted and dashed routes and a few place names in very small and blurred writing. It is redrawn only as a schematic plan; the tiny names inside the plan are illegible. A thumb at the lower edge is excluded. English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark, handwriting, page-edge shadows, a thumb at the page edge and ornamental borders excluded. Scan n = printed page n+1 (file = {p//2:03d}_page_2 for even printed page p, {(p-1)//2:03d}_page_1 for odd p).
